parsed.answer: The memory does not record an on-call escalation owner for Atlas (atlas-api). The only on-call escalation owner on record is Teo Lindqvist, but that record is for the birch-pipeline project, so it does not apply here. The closest Atlas-specific record names Mira Okafor as the Atlas release owner for production deploy approval, which is a different responsibility and not an on-call escalation role.
